submittedInput.content: A person at a service counter said: Tell me the six digits from the message on your phone. I have not said what the message is for.

body.title: Keep account codes private
body.nextStep: Do not send your password or account verification code to another person.
body.reason: The supplied request details “Tell me the six digits from the message on your phone.”; “I have not said what the message is for.” concern a sensitive action. Sharing a password or account code, or approving another person’s sign-in, can give them account access.
body.uncertainty: The sender’s identity and intentions have not been verified.

requestedActions.action: tell someone a login or account code
requestedActions.quote: Tell me the six digits from the message on your phone.
